'''Ballas3''' is an unnamed pedestrian character model in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''. He is a member of the [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]].

He is also available as a playable character in the official [[Multiplayer in GTA San Andreas|2 player mode]] exclusive to the [[PlayStation 2]] version of the game.

==Character==
===Appearance===
Ballas3 wears a black pinstriped beanie, sunglasses, a closed purple [[Prolaps]]-brand windbreaker with a white shirt underneath it, khaki pants and black and white sneakers.

In ''[[Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy - The Definitive Edition|The Definitive Edition]]'', his model has a few variants. His beanie can be plain black or it can have different striped patterns. He can also be seen with a clean, shaved face or with stubble. His pants and shoes change colors as well.

In the [[Beta Content in GTA San Andreas/Characters#Ballas|beta]], Ballas3's jacket was a purple flannel shirt, and he wore faded black jeans instead of khaki pants. He appeared to have a full beard. At one point in development, his beanie was purple instead of black.
